name: Pangolick Quest
storyline: The princess has been kidnapped... and only one unlikely hero can save her: Pangolick, a courageous pangolin with a powerful tongue!
summary: Pangolick Quest is a quirky top-down action-adventure where your tongue is your weapon. Instead of wielding a sword, you lash out at enemies, roll into them, and chain together combos with speed and precision. As you collect pink bugs, your tongue grows longer, opening new paths and secrets. Explore, strategize, and master momentum to uncover this eccentric world’s hidden challenges.
